text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—It's finally here... the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! Finally, I get to face 
McQueen-san...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Mejiro McQueen-san, the one I look up 
to—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, she 
is a "distinguished Umamusume" fulfilling 
her noblesse oblige.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Looking upon that noble figure, I have 
always yearned to reach that same height.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(After entering Tracen Academy, just being 
able to watch McQueen-san run up close 
made me happy.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Chasing the dream of fulfilling the 
Satono family's long-cherished wish, I 
kept running... and before I knew it, I 
had finally arrived.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Onto the same turf as the one I admire—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(...And today, I challenge the person I 
admire as a rival!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I want to show everyone the potential to 
surpass the legendary strongest stayer!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Next to enter are Kitasan Black and Satono 
Diamond! Entering together side by side!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Diamond-chaaaan! Do your beeeeeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Let's take the Tenno Sho (Autumn) title 
too, Kitasan!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, thank you all for waiting!! Who could 
have ever predicted her entry in this 
race?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who once achieved 
back-to-back victories in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)—Mejiro McQueen!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*ROOOOOOOAR!!*)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Just listen to these cheers! Tokyo 
Racecourse is shaking to its core!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Despite the heavy rain, a massive crowd 
has packed the stands to catch a glimpse 
of this dream race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...McQueen-san really is amazing after 
all, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But we're not about to let 
ourselves lose either!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah! If it's us, having made it this far!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I know we can defeat McQueen-san!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"I will take 1st place!!" "1st place is 
gonna be mine!!"
